model_spec.selection: validation crop macro PSNR only; compare selected best and final200k with frozen8k references

protocol.reduced: RAW manifest crop area3 -> network3x vs GT. FP32, clip prediction, border3, no uint8 rounding.
protocol.native: Full RAW -> network3x -> clip0..1 -> area3 -> same manifest crop vs GT. No true3x HR GT.
protocol.comparison: Frozen 8k references versus validation-selected full-run best and last200k. Same samples/crops/normalization; training budget differs. Best selected only by crop validation PSNR. Test reused for development; not blind.
protocol.display: Fixed0..1 to uint8 for all panels; no separate contrast stretching. native_x3_detail keeps actual3x output pixels, GT bilinear3x for style reference only. Phase12 mean spread is diagnostic and affected by scene structure, not a quality acceptance metric.
